Erzvilkas Jewish Cemetery

Jewish Cemetery · Tauragė County, Lithuania

Demolished. Eržvilkas was the birthplace of two notable Jewish figures: translator and historian R. Shimon Glazer (1877–1939), and Professor Hermann Schapira (1840–98), who was the first to propose the establishment of both the Jewish National Fund and the Hebrew University — two of the most consequential institutions in the history of the Zionist movement. Jews settled in Eržvilkas from the early 19th century, reaching 144 people (20 percent) by 1897. Most of the 40–45 Jewish families living there before WWII were killed following the German invasion in 1941; 22 survivors were helped by Lithuanian farmers.
